title: Raindrop Prelude
source: Both hands, the opening section in D-flat (bars 1-27), from Mutopia Project piece 471, "Prelude: Op. 28, No. 15", typeset by Magnus Lewis-Smith from Edition Peters, Public Domain: https://www.mutopiaproject.org/cgibin/piece-info.cgi?id=471 (LilyPond source Chop-28-15-lys.zip, sha256 66ab25a554d012e56b419519fdbef092b12a87b34ada28cd720f97599bff4ed7, exported to MIDI with LilyPond 2.26 with its staff changes off, so the left hand's notes printed on the treble staff stay the left hand's). Ornaments are charted as their main note: the 7-note fioriture in bars 4 and 23 as their first note, held to the beat; grace notes and appoggiaturas are not charted.
